tools.name: hibp_list_breaches
tools.description: List public HIBP breaches, optionally filtered by domain, spam-list flag, and verification status.

tools.name: hibp_get_breach
tools.description: Look up a single public HIBP breach by its canonical breach name, such as Adobe.

tools.name: hibp_get_latest_breach
tools.description: Return the most recently added public breach currently loaded into HIBP.

tools.name: hibp_list_data_classes
tools.description: List the data classes used across public HIBP breach models, such as email addresses or passwords.

tools.name: hibp_get_pwned_passwords_range
tools.description: Query the public Pwned Passwords k-anonymity API with a 5-character SHA-1 or NTLM prefix and return matching suffixes with prevalence counts.

tools.name: hibp_get_breached_account
tools.description: Search HIBP for breaches affecting a single email address. Requires an OAuth bearer token linked to an active HIBP API subscription; use domain and verification filters to refine the result.

tools.name: hibp_get_breached_account_range
tools.description: Query the authenticated HIBP k-anonymity breached-account range endpoint with the first 6 characters of a SHA-1 email hash. Requires a subscription with k-anonymity access; compare each returned suffix with the remaining hash characters locally because a prefix alone cannot identify an account.

tools.name: hibp_get_paste_account
tools.description: Search for public pastes containing a single email address. Requires an OAuth bearer token linked to an active HIBP API subscription; run this separately from breached-account lookup.

tools.name: hibp_get_breached_domain
tools.description: Return breached aliases for a verified domain. This tool requires an authorized subscription via OAuth bearer token.

tools.name: hibp_list_subscribed_domains
tools.description: List the domains associated with the authenticated HIBP subscription.

tools.name: hibp_get_subscription_status
tools.description: Return the current plan, quotas, rate limits, expiry, and feature flags for the active HIBP API subscription linked to the authenticated OAuth connection. Use it to confirm access before feature-dependent lookups.

tools.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email
tools.description: Return website domains historically observed in stealer logs for an email address. Requires an OAuth-linked active subscription with the stealer-log feature; results do not establish current account access.

tools.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain
tools.description: Return email addresses historically observed in stealer logs for a website domain. Requires an OAuth-linked active subscription with the stealer-log feature; results do not establish current account access.

tools.name: hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain
tools.description: Return email aliases and associated website domains historically observed in stealer logs for an email domain. Requires an OAuth-linked active subscription with the stealer-log feature; results do not establish current account access.

tools.name: hibp_generate_domain_verification_dns_token
tools.description: Generate the TXT record value required to verify domain control via DNS, creating or reusing the private HIBP domain-verification records needed for the request. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.

tools.name: hibp_verify_domain_verification_dns_token
tools.description: Complete domain verification by checking the expected HIBP TXT record on the target domain. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.

tools.name: hibp_send_domain_verification_email
tools.description: Send a domain verification email to an approved alias such as admin or security. Requires an authenticated subscription with domain-verification access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_breached_account_range, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain · Private data: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_pwned_passwords_range, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_breached_domain, hibp_generate_domain_verification_dns_token, hibp_verify_domain_verification_dns_token · Public sink: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_breached_account_range, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain, hibp_send_domain_verification_email · Destructive: hibp_get_paste_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_breached_account_range, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain · Private data: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_pwned_passwords_range, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_breached_domain, hibp_generate_domain_verification_dns_token, hibp_verify_domain_verification_dns_token · Public sink: hibp_list_data_classes, hibp_get_breached_account, hibp_get_breached_account_range, hibp_get_paste_account, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_website_domain, hibp_get_stealer_logs_by_email_domain, hibp_send_domain_verification_email · Destructive: hibp_get_paste_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "hibp_get_breached_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search HIBP for breaches affecting a single email address. This tool requires an OAuth bearer token." → after: "Search HIBP for breaches affecting a single email address. Requires an OAuth bearer token linked to an active HIBP API subscription; use domain and verification filters to refine the result."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
